title: Joint Boltzmann–Grad and Long-Time Limits for Lorentz Gases
exact_target: Can dilute-scatterer and long-time asymptotics for the periodic Lorentz gas be justified simultaneously?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002951 (OWR-13861-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Scaling Limits in Models of Statistical Mechanics (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/40, pp. 2329--2398. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 32.
Marklof--Toth, Superdiffusion in the Periodic Lorentz Gas (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Boca--Zaharescu, Periodic Lorentz Gas with Small Scatterers (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The joint scaling relation, normalization and limiting observable are unspecified in the extraction. They must come from the report; unrestricted convergence along every possible pair $(r,t)$ is not silently asserted.
